name: Hase Lanes
about: A proposed layout for the user's approval before the level is built (docs/LEARNINGS.md A8): KM1-1_hase_lanes.png's ensemble, left to right, spread along the lane from the home's front door (x = -12, where every story level starts) to Hase Station's platform. Game axes: x along the lane (m), z away from the camera (the green walking strip, the play lane, at z = 0), front: the z of a model's street face. Kit: the Kamakura kit (Art/Models/Kamakura, and the home from kit_buildings_km.py).

placements.note: the home and its fence: the level starts at its door
KM-A22, the home's outdoor unit on its stand
the convex mirror at the kerb
the blue machine (KM-A19) beside the red
the recycling bins (KM-A20): a crow on them
the little shrine's torii, up its steps
the delivery scooter, parked at a door while its rider delivers
a plain pole with a street lamp (KM-A26)
the crossing's bells and lamps, this side
the tram coming down the tracks to the crossing (toward the camera, as Crossing's traffic)
the overhead wire gantry over the tracks

markers.what: potted plants and morning glories (KM-F04 to come)
steps up to the shrine (in its model)
hydrangeas, pink and violet (KM-G19, G20; KM-F04 to come)

play.what: start: out of the home's door (the home stem)
the ginger cat on the block wall (WallCat): it swipes at a ball kicked high
first-graders walking to school in a line, slower than the kid: get past without the ball touching one (Pedestrian bump)
the little shrine up its steps: coins on the steps' line
the parked scooter: dribble round it (an obstacle), its rider walking a parcel to the door
the level crossing: the bells ring, the barriers come down, the tram passes; wait, then cross (Crossing, with the tram as its traffic)
Hase Station's platform: the stop (the leg ends; KM1-2 rides the tram)
